elements.description: Grouped bar chart titled 'Statistical Performance Index scores, 2019'. Y-axis: 'Score', scale 0 to 100 with gridlines at 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100. X-axis categories: 'Pillar 1 - Data Use', 'Pillar 2 - Data Services', 'Pillar 3 - Data Products', 'Pillar 4 - Data Sources', 'Pillar 5 - Data Infrastructure', 'SPI Overall score'. Legend: 'Lower middle income' (teal), 'East Asia and Pacific' (orange), 'Vietnam' (grey). No values are printed on the bars. Approximate readings: Pillar 1 - Data Use: Lower middle income ~79, East Asia and Pacific ~70, Vietnam ~100. Pillar 2 - Data Services: Lower middle income ~63, East Asia and Pacific ~67, Vietnam ~64. Pillar 3 - Data Products: Lower middle income ~61, East Asia and Pacific ~49, Vietnam ~55. Pillar 4 - Data Sources: Lower middle income ~41, East Asia and Pacific ~47, Vietnam ~76. Pillar 5 - Data Infrastructure: Lower middle income ~40, East Asia and Pacific ~45, Vietnam ~35. SPI Overall score: Lower middle income ~57, East Asia and Pacific ~60, Vietnam ~66. Vietnam is highest on Pillars 1 and 4 and the overall score, and lowest on Pillar 5, where it trails both comparison groups; the other pillars are fairly close across the three groups.
